In this video, I put 0x Alpha to the test by making it recreate Minecraft and GTA 6 from scratch. 🎮🤖

Play the games 🎮

Minecraft Clone: https://minecraft-0x-alpha.netlify.app/

GTA 6 Clone: https://gta6-0x-alpha.netlify.app/

Chapters ⏱️

00:00 Intro
00:17 Prompting 0x Alpha
00:33 Minecraft Clone Playtest
06:34 Prompting 0x Alpha
06:44 GTA 6 Clone Playtest
09:14 Outro

0x Alpha is a mysterious new AI coding model that has been getting a lot of attention, so I wanted to see how good it actually is at building full games. I tested what it could create, how well the games worked, and whether the model is actually worth the hype. 🔥

Disclaimer: No copyrighted game assets from Minecraft/Mojang or GTA 6/Rockstar Games were used in these projects. All game assets were procedurally generated.
